text:
Ana: SummitCare asked for a short-term egress bump + enable us-east for lower latency during onboarding. They also want an IP allowlist for CICD runners. Renewal flagged as at-risk if onboarding delays continue. Need eng + network signoff.

Mike: Can you paste the tenant id and current qps?

Ana: Tenant: summitcare-prod-42. Current sustained qps ~120, asking for 250 burst. Renewal in ~45 days. Health score: yellow (onboarding lag + 2 NPS -1).

Tara: We can do a temp rate increase but must check dedicated pool contention. Which pool are they on?

Sanjay: They're on pool-ded-3 (eu-west). If we open us-east routing we should add a fallback policy and ensure billing routing is set. Confirm CIDRs.

Ana: CIDRs from the customer: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.32/27, 198.51.100.64/27 (CICD runners + on-prem cache).

Mike: Ops runbook snippet to apply (for net/eng):
```json
{"tenant":"summitcare-prod-42","allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.32/27","198.51.100.64/27"],"rate_override":{"window":"72h","multiplier":"2x"},"regions_add":["us-east-1"]}
```

Tara: I'll validate pool capacity. If contention, spin up a burst node in us-east with tag `summit-burst`. ETA 1-2h.

OpsBot: Deploy job queued: deploy-allowlist-3620001240. Will post status.

Ana: SummitCare PM says they have a demo at 10:00 PT tomorrow and want no drops. Can we prioritize?

Sanjay: I'll pre-provision routes and set fallback to eu-west if us-east latency >200ms. Enabling enhanced logging.

Mike: Capture feedback action: Ana to collect demo notes + NPS after demo; I'll follow up on renewal if demo goes well.

Tara: Patch ready, rolling 1/3 now. Monitor per-route latency + token cost. If anyone sees error spikes ping me.

OpsBot: deploy-allowlist-3620001240 started at 3620001250, status: in_progress.

Ana: Thanks team. Marking renewal risk to 'watch' once demo completes. I'll update CRM.

OpsBot: deploy-allowlist-3620001240 completed at 3620001520, status: success.

Sanjay: us-east routing active. No errors in initial test. 95th latency ~78ms.

Mike: Noted. Ana, please send SummitCare a quick checklist for the demo: region change note, expected cold-start behavior, reachability IPs.

Ana: Will do. Template: ```Checklist:
- Confirm IPs allowed
- Run smoke test against us-east
- Verify tokens and billing
- Report any 5xx immediately to #support
``` :white_check_mark:

Tara: Leaving monitoring hooks for token cost and 5xx alerts. If we see >1% 5xx during demo we roll back routing.

Ana: Follow-up: PM okayed 72h bump. I'll collect post-demo feedback and NPS.

Mike: I'll schedule a renewal check-in for 1 week after the demo to review OKRs.

Sanjay: Closing loop on network side — routes, fallback, and logs in place.

Ana: Closing thread for now, will re-open if anything pops up during the demo.
